metadata.title: Zomato Restaurant Analysis
metadata.subtitle: Restaurant Analytics & Business Intelligence Dashboard
metadata.description: An exploratory data analysis project focused on restaurant ratings, pricing, cuisines, locations, delivery services, customer engagement, and business insights.

outliers.takeaway: Restaurants with 10,000+ votes are REAL famous brands and high costs are real fine-dining venues. They are valuable business signals, not data errors.

insights.headline: Fix the Ratings Gap: 22.5% of Restaurants Unrated
insights.explanation: Nearly a quarter of restaurants have an Aggregate Rating of 0 ('Not rated'). This creates massive visibility and trust blindspots for customers.

insights.headline: Promote Online Delivery: Significant Rating Advantage
insights.explanation: Only 25.7% of restaurants offer online delivery. Those offering delivery have higher average ratings and 2.3x more customer engagement.

insights.headline: Table Booking Is Severely Underused in Fine Dining
insights.explanation: Only 12.1% of restaurants enable table booking, yet they achieve a 3.44 average rating and attract 6.8x more votes (627 vs 92).

insights.headline: Premium Restaurants Perform Better, But Quality Matters
insights.stat: 3.89 Rating for Range 4 vs 3.24 for Range 1
insights.explanation: Price Range 4 achieves 3.89 average rating vs 3.24 for Range 1. However, raw cost correlation is weak (0.052), proving price alone does not guarantee satisfaction.

insights.headline: Votes Are a Strong Signal of Platform Trust
insights.explanation: The correlation of 0.41 between votes and ratings indicates that highly engaged restaurants have solidified reputations and repeat diners.

insights.headline: Winning Cuisines vs Market Saturation
insights.stat: Italian (3.95) & American (3.92) vs North Indian (936 outlets)
insights.explanation: Italian and American cuisines lead customer ratings, while North Indian has the highest outlet density (936), signaling intense local market competition.

insights.headline: Over 80% Restaurant Concentration in Delhi NCR
insights.stat: 7,671 / 9,551 Outlets in New Delhi, Gurgaon & Noida
insights.explanation: Just 3 cities account for over 80% of all restaurants. Zomato faces geographic concentration risk and has vast expansion runway in Tier-2 Indian cities.

insights.headline: Multi-Country Currency & Clean Data Quality
insights.explanation: The dataset spans 15 countries with multiple local currencies. Filtering by Indian Rupees (Rs.) isolates the domestic core for like-for-like analysis.

recommendations.title: Closing the 22.5% Ratings Gap via Customer Incentives
recommendations.observation: Over 2,148 restaurants (22.5%) have an aggregate rating of 0 ('Not rated').
recommendations.evidence: 22.49% unrated rate, skewing aggregate rating distribution with skewness of -0.954.
recommendations.business_meaning: Unrated restaurants lose customer conversions because diners hesitate to order without social proof. It undermines platform trust.
recommendations.action: Deploy gamified review prompts, push notifications post-delivery, and review rewards (Zomato Pro points / discounts) to turn unrated restaurants into reviewed listings within 14 days of joining.

recommendations.title: Onboarding High-Performing Dine-In Restaurants to Online Delivery
recommendations.observation: Only 25.7% of listed restaurants have online delivery enabled.
recommendations.evidence: Delivery-enabled restaurants average 3.25 rating across all venues (3.38 rated) and gather 272 average votes vs 117 for non-delivery.
recommendations.business_meaning: Restaurants with delivery exhibit substantially higher customer engagement and satisfaction. Non-delivery restaurants leave high-margin delivery revenue on the table.
recommendations.action: Create a dedicated merchant onboarding program targeting the 74.3% non-delivery restaurants, starting with high-rating Dine-in establishments in New Delhi and Gurgaon.

recommendations.title: Expanding Table Booking Monetization in Premium Outlets
recommendations.observation: Table booking adoption is critically low at only 12.1% of all listings.
recommendations.evidence: Table booking venues maintain a 3.44 overall average rating (3.59 rated) and command 627 average votes vs 92 for non-booking restaurants.
recommendations.business_meaning: Fine-dining and casual-dining customers place immense value on reservation convenience, driving loyalty and higher average ticket sizes.
recommendations.action: Bundle table booking capabilities into premium merchant tier packages, especially for Price Range 3 and 4 establishments in urban hubs.

recommendations.title: Geographic Diversification Beyond Delhi NCR into Tier-2 Hubs
recommendations.observation: Over 80% of listings are concentrated across New Delhi (5,473), Gurgaon (1,118), and Noida (1,080).
recommendations.evidence: 7,671 out of 9,551 total restaurants are in the NCR corridor, while major cities like Kolkata, Bangalore, and Pune have fewer than 25 listings in this dataset.
recommendations.business_meaning: Zomato carries severe regional concentration exposure, while high-growth emerging tech and culinary capitals represent untapped platform market share.
recommendations.action: Allocate merchant acquisition teams to tier-1 and tier-2 growth cities (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chandigarh) where cuisine diversification and digital dining adoption are accelerating.

eda_workflow.finding: Defined key business questions and analytical framework for restaurant performance.
9,551 rows × 21 columns, multi-country international dataset with mixed data types.
9 missing values in Cuisines column (imputed as 'Unknown'), 0 duplicate rows.
22.5% restaurants are 'Not Rated', 46.5% belong to Price Range 1, skewness is -0.954.
Positive correlation between price range & rating; Online delivery restaurants have higher ratings.
New Delhi dominates across all metrics; delivery rating advantage persists across top cities.
1,126 IQR outliers in votes; identified as genuine brand popularity rather than data errors.
Votes vs rating r = 0.41; Italian & American cuisines lead ratings; North Indian leads volume.
Formulated 8 evidence-backed business insights and 4 actionable recommendations.
Engineered clean dataset features (binary flags, Is Rated) ready for production analytics.
